about: Per-throw reference events from public Kubb video, measured frame by frame. Times are seconds into the source video. Pass 1 (the first 22 events): mixed clips, lengths in kubb lengths (15 cm) where the camera gives no better scale. Pass 2 (setup 'cage camera'): national-final videos from a fixed corner camera, positions in metres on the pitch (x across from one sideline, y from the near baseline) from a ground homography; 'measured' says whether an event has positions ('full') or outcomes only. See REALCLIPS.md.
